correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all 121 tetrahedra of the exact or_0.94270736 Weeks complex, f=(18,139,242,121), connected graph-cycle rank 122. Independently selected a 122×122 facial-relation minor with exact determinant −25 and computed full mod-5 rank 120, forcing integral H1=(Z/5)^2 with no additional torsion. Computed exact mod-5 cocycles and exhaustively evaluated all 619 graph cliques: 242 faces and 377 nonfaces, each nonface nonzero. Recomputed all 12 ±-class-pair multiplicities 11,15,15,17,19,30,33,39,45,49,52,52 and six projective totals 50,50,60,64,71,82; reversing orientation hits all 24 nonzero classes. This is finite exhaustive for the prescribed facet set.
